name: Uvena Prime
description: Uvena Prime, also known as Uvena, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Shistavanen species. Located in the Uvena system in the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a world of forested continents and vast oceans. Shistavanens most often remained on their homeworld, distrusting outsiders, though some natives left for the wider galaxy.
